items.note: The checks now state results ("One row shows 6 for all students and 4 for students with a city recorded"; "Each value is computed from the fee column of courses"), not functions. Hints ask the learner to decide which COUNT form or aggregate gives each figure. At work reads "two counts side by side in one query answer it". The learner must now choose COUNT(*) against COUNT(city), and SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX, unaided.
The worked examples no longer mirror the tasks. Activity 2 shows COUNT(grade) alone, with COUNT(*)'s result given in prose. Activity 3 shows only AVG and MAX, with SUM and MIN described in words.

Partly fixed. Replayed on this page: the starter, a missing comma and a missing semicolon now show "Error", not "Not in this practice editor". A misspelled keyword ("SELEC * FROM students;") still shows "Not in this practice editor" ("This practice editor runs SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE statements; it could not read one starting \"selec\""). The limits list still says that label is "not a sign that your SQL is wrong". The cause is the controller.js EDITOR.check exemption regex, which keeps any message containing "practice editor runs SELECT" as a limit.

The recap now says "Used on their own, aggregates turn all the rows they read into one summary row."
